issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Appxiom
products.tagline: Context layer for AI coding agents to detect & fix bugs
products.summaryZh: 为AI编码代理提供上下文层，以检测并修复错误
products.descriptionZh: Appxiom 为你的编码代理提供其缺失的生产环境上下文：移动端和 Web 应用中的崩溃、卡顿、内存泄漏、网络请求失败和用户流程中断。Goal Friction Impact 让代理根据缺陷所损害的目标来排定优先级。支持 Android（Kotlin、Jetpack Compose、Java）、iOS（Swift、SwiftUI、Objective-C）、Flutter、Kotlin Multiplatform 和 Web（所有 JavaScript / TypeScript 框架，特别支持 React）。
products.description: Appxiom gives your coding agent the production context it lacks: crashes, freezes, memory leaks, failed network calls and broken user journeys in mobile and web applications. Goal Friction Impact lets agents prioritise bugs by the goals they cost you. Supports Android (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Java), iOS (Swift, SwiftUI, Objective-C), Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform and Web (all JavaScript / TypeScript frameworks, with special support for React).

products.name: seshka
products.tagline: Kill what Claude Code left behind
products.summaryZh: 清除 Claude Code 遗留的内容
products.descriptionZh: Claude Code 会话结束，但它们启动的开发服务器、监视器和脚本不会停止。seshka 会在菜单栏中按会话分组显示这些进程，并附带内存和端口信息。一键即可终止。空闲会话也能结束，手动或自动均可。免费且开源。
products.description: Claude Code sessions end. The dev servers, watchers and scripts they started don't. seshka shows them in your menu bar, grouped by session, with memory and ports. Kill them in one click. End idle sessions too, by hand or automatically. Free and open source.

products.name: Ridian
products.tagline: The AI-first scheduling suite for everything around meetings
products.summaryZh: 以AI为核心的日程管理套件，全面覆盖会议相关事务
products.descriptionZh: Ridian 是一套 AI 优先的日程安排套件。支持带付款、等候名单、群组和团队的预约页面。漏斗会提出恰当的问题，并将每个潜在客户引导至正确的通话。内置 CRM，每一条预约和漏斗回答都会汇入其中。日历和联系人可在 Google、Microsoft、iCloud 等平台间同步。连接你所有的日历和收件箱，让 Claude、ChatGPT 或 Alvin 开箱即用地处理。你甚至可以为你的代理分配专属邮箱。围绕会议的一切，皆已处理妥当。
products.description: Ridian is an AI-first scheduling suite. Booking pages with payments, waitlists, groups and teams. Funnels that ask the right questions and send every lead to the right call. A built-in CRM where every booking and funnel answer lands. Calendar and contact sync across Google, Microsoft, iCloud and more. Connect all your calendars and inboxes and let Claude, ChatGPT or Alvin handle it out of the box. You can even give your agents their own mailbox. Everything around your meetings, handled.

products.name: pushr
products.tagline: iPhone push alerts from any script, server or AI agent
products.summaryZh: 来自任何脚本、服务器或 AI 代理的 iPhone 推送提醒
products.descriptionZh: 通过一个 HTTP 请求，即可从任何脚本、服务器、cron 任务或 AI 代理向你的 iPhone 发送推送。无需 SDK。订单、付款、部署和故障都汇聚到同一个信息流中，每条都带有自己的标志和颜色。长时间任务支持实时活动，可从锁定屏幕回复，闹钟会持续响铃直到你确认，还提供正常运行时间和心跳监控。提供免费方案，需要更多功能时可选择 Pro。后端开源（MIT），可自行托管。
products.description: Send a push to your iPhone from any script, server, cron job or AI agent with one HTTP request. No SDK. Orders, payouts, deploys and outages land in one feed, each with its own logo and color. Live Activities for long jobs, replies from the Lock Screen, alarms that ring until you acknowledge them, plus uptime and heartbeat monitors. Free plan, Pro when you need more. The backend is open source (MIT) and self-hostable.

products.name: Dialect
products.tagline: Give the physical world an API
products.summaryZh: 赋予物理世界一个API
products.descriptionZh: 把任意摄像头对准你原本得走过去查看的东西：一个隔间、一个货架、一个阀门、一扇门。用通俗英语说明要关注什么。Dialect 的智能体无需训练即可建立一个带类型的端点，持续读取它，并通过 REST、MCP 和 webhook 提供答案，还带告警。当它不确定时，会直接说明，而不是猜测。首次回答免费；每月 99 美元覆盖你的第一个事项。
products.description: Point any camera at something you'd otherwise walk over to check: a bay, a shelf, a valve, a door. Say what to watch in plain English. Dialect's agent sets up a typed endpoint with nothing to train, keeps reading it, and serves the answer over REST, MCP and webhooks, with alerts. When it isn't sure, it says so instead of guessing. Your first answer is free; $99 a month covers your first thing.

products.name: Skiss
products.tagline: Save websites with their fonts, colours and real CSS
products.summaryZh: 保存网站及其字体、颜色和真实 CSS
products.descriptionZh: Skiss 会按你发现网站当天的样子将其保存下来：桌面端和手机端的整页截图，以及从代码中读取的颜色、字体和版块。你可以搜索自己的资料库、比较不同版本，并让 Claude、ChatGPT、Cursor 或 Figma 基于它进行设计。
products.description: Skiss saves a website the way it looked the day you found it: full-page screenshots on desktop and phone, plus its colours, fonts and sections, read from the code. Search your library, compare versions, and let Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or Figma design from it.

products.name: Bezzle
products.tagline: A whole design studio, free, on your Mac and PC
products.summaryZh: 一整套设计工作室，免费，适用于你的Mac和PC
products.descriptionZh: 还记得你真正拥有设计软件的那些日子吗？Bezzle 把那种感觉带回来了，而且完全免费。它能在你的 Mac 或 PC 上运行，打开你的 Figma、Sketch、Adobe XD 和 Photoshop 文件，完成全部工作：组件、原型、交付、一键深色模式、实时协同编辑、动画、矢量、抠图和照片编辑。过去需要四个应用，现在一个就够了。没有订阅，无需账户，也没人计算你的席位。
products.description: Remember when you owned your design software? Bezzle brings that back, and it costs nothing. It runs on your Mac or PC, opens your Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD and Photoshop files, and does the whole job: components, prototypes, hand-off, dark mode in one click, live co-editing, animation, vectors, cutouts and photo edits. One app where you used to need four. No subscription, no account, and nobody counting your seats.

products.name: polyroom
products.tagline: Where AI agents work together and your team decides
products.summaryZh: AI代理协同工作，由你的团队决策
products.descriptionZh: 你的智能体在此协同工作，由你的团队做决定，无论每个智能体在何处运行。Claude Code、Codex 及其他受支持的 MCP 客户端与你的团队加入同一个共享空间。它们认领卡片、相互提及，并将决策提交给负责审批的人。每个智能体仍在原本运行的位置继续运行。共享工作区包含聊天、看板和已记录的决策。
products.description: Where your agents work together and your team decides, wherever each agent runs. Claude Code, Codex and other supported MCP clients join one shared room with your team. They claim cards, mention each other and bring decisions to the people who approve them. Each agent keeps running where it already runs. The shared workspace includes chat, kanban boards and recorded decisions.

products.name: Mr.Speech
products.tagline: Turns your meetings into action. Now with agents.
products.summaryZh: 将会议转化为行动。现已支持智能代理。
products.descriptionZh: Mr.Speech 在你的电脑上录制会议，无需机器人加入通话，并将会议内容转化为一份由你批准的方案。本次发布的新功能：智能代理。连接 Gmail、Calendar、Slack、Notion 等数十种服务，然后向 Mr. AI 询问后续事项。它会读取会议内容和你的笔记，准备好邮件、日历条目或消息，并等待你点击确认。未经你点击，不会发送任何内容。支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux，并提供免费方案。
products.description: Mr.Speech records your meetings on your computer, with no bot in the call, and turns them into a plan you approve. New in this launch: agents. Connect Gmail, Calendar, Slack, Notion and dozens more, then ask Mr. AI for the follow-up. It reads the meeting and your notes, prepares the email, calendar entry or message, and waits for your click. Nothing is sent without it. macOS, Windows and Linux, with a free plan.

products.name: Pangular Inspector
products.tagline: The unified Angular devtools
products.summaryZh: 统一的 Angular 开发者工具
products.descriptionZh: 检查 Angular 组件、信号、依赖注入、路由、表单和存储。可在页面中、通过 CLI，或经由 MCP 使用编码代理进行检查。
products.description: Inspect Angular components, signals, dependency injection, routes, forms and stores. In the page, from the CLI, or through a coding agent over MCP.

products.name: roko browser
products.tagline: Super Fast & Distraction Free Browser for iPhone
products.summaryZh: iPhone 上超快速且无干扰的浏览器
products.descriptionZh: 直达你所求，无需等待，也没有弹窗。roko 在 160 毫秒内打开，在我们的测试中加载页面的速度比 Safari 快至 5 倍，并在排名前 9,000 的网站中 99% 的页面上，于页面绘制前清除广告、跟踪器和 Cookie 弹窗。下拉即可总结页面，或直接提问，它会为你阅读网页，可使用 Apple 的设备端 AI 或你自己的 API 密钥。同一个栏还支持语音和与提醒事项同步的待办事项。无需账户，无跟踪。在 App Store 免费提供。
products.description: Get to what you came for, without the wait or the pop-ups. roko opens in 160 ms, loads pages up to 5x faster than Safari in our tests, and clears ads, trackers and cookie pop-ups before the page draws on 99% of the top 9,000 sites. Pull down to summarize a page, or ask and it reads the web for you, with Apple's on-device AI or your own API key. One bar also takes voice and to-dos synced with Reminders. No account, no tracking. Free on App Store.

products.name: FrameExtractor
products.tagline: Pull the best frames from any video
products.summaryZh: 从任何视频中提取最佳画面
products.descriptionZh: 将屏幕录制和视频片段转化为清晰、可直接使用的静帧。FrameExtractor 在您的设备上私密地找出独特帧并预选最佳帧。免费试用，无需账户。Pro 版增加无限视频、批量 ZIP 下载、高质量 JPG 和无损 PNG 导出，以及桌面端设备上的英文转录。一次付费，终身使用。
products.description: Turn screen recordings and video clips into sharp, ready-to-use stills. FrameExtractor finds unique frames and pre-selects the best ones, privately on your device. Free to try, with no account required. Pro adds unlimited videos, bulk ZIP downloads, high-quality JPG and lossless PNG exports, and on-device English transcripts on desktop. One payment, lifetime access.

products.name: EveryApp
products.tagline: Every app you need. Even the ones that don't exist.
products.summaryZh: 你需要的每个应用，甚至那些还不存在的。
products.descriptionZh: EveryApp 将 300 多款免费工具、应用和游戏汇集一处：编辑 PDF、照片和视频，记录习惯和账单，畅玩 70 款游戏。每款应用均可在网页端打开，或安装到手机、电脑上。找不到想要的应用？用你自己的话描述它，我们便为你构建，配有独立网址，供你和受邀的人使用。无需编程。个人应用时代已经到来：软件为一个人而造，而非为千百万人。
products.description: EveryApp puts 300+ free tools, apps and games in one place: edit PDFs, photos and video, track habits and bills, play 70 games. Every app opens on the web or installs on your phone or computer. Can't find the app you want? Describe it in your own words and we build it for you, with its own web address, for you and the people you invite. No coding. The era of personal apps is here: software made for one person, not for millions.

products.name: Waggle
products.tagline: One inbox for every decision your AI agents need
products.summaryZh: 一个收件箱，承载 AI 智能体所需的每一项决策
products.descriptionZh: Waggle 是一款免费、开源的 Mac 应用，你的 AI 代理会在这里向你请求决策和审核。Claude Code、Codex、Claude 应用和 Cowork 通过 MCP 发送它们的问题。每个请求都会显示代理需要什么、为什么无法决定、有哪些选项以及它的建议。对于 UI 工作，你可以点击浏览代理的原型，并在上面固定评论。你的回答会返回到同一会话，代理继续执行。所有内容都保留在你的 Mac 上。
products.description: Waggle is a free, open-source Mac app where your AI agents ask you for decisions and reviews. Claude Code, Codex, the Claude app and Cowork send their questions through MCP. Each request shows what the agent needs, why it can't decide, the options and its recommendation. For UI work, click through the agent's prototype and pin comments on it. Your answer goes back to the same session, and the agent keeps going. Everything stays on your Mac.

products.name: Lantern
products.tagline: Map your codebase and review PRs for your AI coding agents
products.summaryZh: 为你的 AI 编程代理映射代码库并审查 PR
products.descriptionZh: Lantern 将你的代码库映射为一张图，帮助你规划变更，按审查顺序以生成的流程和差异审查拉取请求，并在一款桌面应用中监视你所有的 Claude Code 和 Codex 会话。开源、本地优先、MIT 许可。
products.description: Lantern maps your codebase into a graph, helps you plan changes, reviews pull requests with generated flows and diffs in review order, and watches all your Claude Code and Codex sessions in one desktop app. Open source, local-first, MIT.

products.name: FirstTake
products.tagline: Make complete films with an AI agent on your Mac
products.summaryZh: 在Mac上使用AI代理制作完整影片
products.descriptionZh: FirstTake 可将影片创意在 Mac 上变成完成的 MP4。其 AI 智能体负责规划场景、生成镜头、添加配音和音乐、剪辑并导出。付费步骤前可查看模型和预估费用。可使用内置智能体，或通过 MCP 连接 Claude、Cursor 或 Codex。通常一次性支付 9 美元，获得终身许可和更新。Product Hunt：前 50 名购买者使用 FIRSTTAKEPH 可享 5 美元。自带提供商密钥；生成费用另行计费。
products.description: FirstTake turns a film idea into a finished MP4 on your Mac. Its AI agent plans scenes, generates shots, adds voices and music, edits and exports. See the model and estimated cost before paid steps. Use the built-in agent or connect Claude, Cursor or Codex through MCP. Normally $9 once for a lifetime licence and updates. Product Hunt: $5 for the first 50 buyers with FIRSTTAKEPH. Bring your own provider keys; generation is billed separately.

products.name: ArtefactFlow
products.tagline: Everything you ship, tracked from build to production
products.summaryZh: 从构建到生产，全程追踪您交付的一切
products.descriptionZh: 每个产物、其版本和SBOM的唯一可信来源。了解发布内容、是否存在漏洞及其运行位置，从CI到现场设备。专为欧盟《网络弹性法案》打造，API优先，按组织统一收费。
products.description: One source of truth for every artefact, its versions and its SBOM. Know what's inside a release, whether it's vulnerable and where it runs, from CI to devices in the field. Built for the EU Cyber Resilience Act, API-first, flat price per organisation.

products.name: UI Raptor
products.tagline: Inspect live websites like design files.
products.summaryZh: 像检查设计文件一样检查线上网站。
products.descriptionZh: UI Raptor 是一款免费的 Chrome 扩展，能像查看设计文件一样检查实时网站。在熟悉的面板中探索图层、布局、样式和 CSS。用标尺和参考线测量，直接在页面上调整网格叠加的列，并用 X-Ray 揭示其结构。拾取颜色、检查对比度、预览屏幕尺寸，并探索字体、令牌和资源。将评论固定到元素上，然后连同上下文复制 CSS 或反馈，供开发者或编码代理使用。无需账户或付费。
products.description: UI Raptor is a free Chrome extension for inspecting live websites like a design file. Explore layers, layout, styles and CSS in familiar panels. Measure with rulers and guides, adjust a grid overlay’s columns directly on the page, and use X-Ray to reveal its structure. Pick colors, check contrast, preview screen sizes and explore fonts, tokens and assets. Pin comments to elements, then copy CSS or feedback with context for developers or coding agents. No account or payment required.

products.name: Superclip
products.tagline: Clipboard history and a smart notch for Windows
products.summaryZh: 剪贴板历史记录与Windows智能凹口
products.descriptionZh: Superclip 将剪贴板历史、音乐控制、视频、专注工具和 AI 使用情况整合到紧凑的 Windows 刘海或侧边面板中。无需在窗口间翻找，即可查找复制的文本、链接、图像等内容。你的剪贴板历史保留在你的电脑上。一次性购买；Mac 版本即将推出。
products.description: Superclip brings clipboard history, music controls, video, focus tools and AI usage into a compact Windows notch or side panel. Find copied text, links, images and more without hunting through windows. Your clipboard history stays on your PC. One-time purchase; Mac version coming soon.

products.name: GTA 6 Interactive Map
products.tagline: A GTA 6 map where you share and discover Vice City's secrets
products.summaryZh: 一个GTA 6地图，在这里你可以分享和发现罪恶都市的秘密。
products.descriptionZh: 探索 GTA 6 地点，发现社区建议，并在互动地图上分享你的发现。浏览罪恶都市的秘密，在社区探索的同时帮助完善地图。
products.description: Explore GTA 6 locations, discover community suggestions, and share your own finds on an interactive map. Browse Vice City’s secrets and help build the map as the community explores.
